_note: PUT via automation/deploy-pricing.mjs --only=youtube-video-scraper. PAY_PER_EVENT only on BRONZE plan, startedAt 14+ days out. Apify auto-adds 20% margin. Keyless YouTube SSR blob (ytInitialData / ytInitialPlayerResponse), no proxy. Bad input and fetch failures free.

video_row.eventDescription: One YouTube video from a search, a channel listing or a video-details lookup, with title, views, date, duration, channel and thumbnail. Bad input and videos that could not be fetched are free. First 2 rows per run are free.
